entities.summary: Evan Blake Smith is an American former professional football player who was a center in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Idaho State Bengals. Smith played in the NFL with the Green Bay Packers, Seattle Seahawks, and Tampa Bay Buccaneers. He won Super Bowl XLV as a member of the Packers.
